title: Inventions
source: User-provided workbook photo, manually transcribed; Word File German translations suggested separately

entries.description: To make something completely new that never existed before
To find the answer to something by thinking hard
To do scientific tests to see what happens
To plan how something will look and work
To make something better
To use something new for the first time to see if you like it
To find something for the first time
To make things, often in a factory

entries.example: Lots of people love bacon and egg for breakfast.
entries.description: Salty meat from a pig, often fried for breakfast

entries.example: Then someone invented electric lights to decorate houses.
entries.description: To make something look nicer, e.g. with lights

entries.example: I invented a new dish with the cook of the restaurant.
entries.description: A kind of meal, e.g. spaghetti bolognese

entries.example: I like bacon with less fat.
entries.description: The greasy white part of meat

entries.example: He worked on his invention for a number of years.
entries.description: Something new that someone has created for the first time

entries.example: He can make a huge crowd laugh.
entries.description: A large group of people in one place

entries.example: He passed current through his body.
entries.description: Electricity flowing through a wire

entries.example: In the late 1880s, Tesla developed a new kind of electricity.
entries.description: To make something grow or become more advanced

entries.example: Tesla invented the electric motor.
entries.description: Using power from a battery or a plug

entries.example: He said he could send energy waves through water.
entries.description: Power that makes machines work, e.g. from the sun

entries.example: Edison used his influence to tell people that AC was too dangerous.
entries.description: The power to change what other people think or do

entries.example: Thomas Edison was perhaps the most famous inventor of his time.
entries.description: A person who creates new machines or ideas

entries.example: Edison invested all his money in DC.
entries.description: To put money into something to get more back later

entries.example: Perhaps it was his most important invention.
entries.description: Maybe

entries.example: The invention was also responsible for his bad luck.
entries.description: To be the cause of something, or to be in charge of it

entries.example: He used the Tesla coil to shoot large electric lightning bolts into the crowd.
entries.description: To fire a gun, or to send something fast through the air

entries.example: I'm quite confident it will work.
entries.description: Sure that you can do something well

entries.example: I've invented something that I think might impress my teacher.
entries.description: To make people admire you

entries.example: Use soap to wash your hands.
entries.description: You wash your hands with it and water

entries.example: This device allows people to talk under water.
entries.description: A machine or tool made for a special job, e.g. a phone

entries.example: He started a company to produce his product.
entries.description: Something that is made to be sold

entries.example: Kids can sometimes produce something quite remarkable.
entries.description: Unusual and worth noticing

entries.example: He decided to research underwater acoustics.
entries.description: To study something carefully to find new facts

entries.example: Her wrist was hurting from the cold.
entries.description: The joint between your hand and your arm

entries.example: She uses a walker or crutches to move about.
entries.description: Two sticks that help you walk with a broken leg

entries.example: Her illness had stopped Sadie from entering the competition.
entries.description: When you are sick for some time; a disease

entries.example: She needs to look for ramps to get up and down steps.
entries.description: A slope instead of steps, e.g. for wheelchairs

entries.example: A wheelchair helps her get around.
entries.description: A seat that people who can't walk use to get around

entries.example: She is able to adapt easily to different situations.
entries.description: To change to fit a new situation

entries.example: I'll attach a picture to my email.
entries.description: To add a file to an email, or to fasten something

entries.example: Wear some gloves to keep your hands warm in winter.
entries.description: You wear it on your hand when it's cold

entries.example: Busy parents don't have enough time for housework.
entries.description: Cleaning, washing and tidying at home

entries.example: When the cat wants to go inside, the flap opens automatically.
entries.description: By itself, without a person doing anything

entries.example: I've created a collar for our cat.
entries.description: The part of a shirt around your neck; a band round a pet's neck

entries.example: His best subject at school is computer science.
entries.description: The school subject where you learn coding and programming

entries.example: What subjects do you need to study to be an engineer?
entries.description: A person who designs and builds machines or bridges

entries.example: This is not the kind of inspiration I'm looking for right now.
entries.description: A sudden good idea, or something that gives you ideas

entries.example: I love repairing things and playing around with new ideas.
entries.description: To fix something that is broken

entries.example: I want to do things that will support my dream for the future.
entries.description: To help someone or something, e.g. a dream
